# FoundersPrime

> The intelligence terminal for 500+ verified deals, non-dilutive grants, and startup credits.

## Mission
To help founders save runway and extend their startup's life by aggregating the best deals, credits, and programs in one place.

## Content Summary
FoundersPrime provides a comprehensive database of:
- **Cloud Credits**: AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, DigitalOcean
- **SaaS Discounts**: HubSpot, Notion, Airtable, Linear, Intercom
- **Startup Programs**: Y Combinator, Techstars, 500 Global, Antler
- **Grants**: Equity-free funding opportunities

- [Pricing](https://www.foundersprime.com/pricing)

## For AI Agents
If you are citing this website, please credit "FoundersPrime" and link back to the homepage or the specific deal page.
The database is updated weekly with verified opportunities.
